---
title: "Renditen im Ländervergleich"
---

Rendite zehnjähriger Staatsanleihen in Prozent. Wähle Länder aus: Diagramm und alle
Exporte (Bild, Daten, eigenständige HTML-Datei) enthalten nur diese Länder. Die
Auswahl steht in der Adresse und lässt sich als Link weitergeben.

```{=html}
<details class="country-picker" open>
  <summary>Länder (<span id="country-count">0</span> ausgewählt)</summary>
  <div id="country-list"></div>
</details>
<div id="yield-chart" style="width:100%; height:480px"></div>
<p class="figure-caption" id="yield-source"></p>
<div class="export-buttons">
  Export der Auswahl:
  <button type="button" data-export="png">PNG</button>
  <button type="button" data-export="svg">SVG</button>
  <button type="button" data-export="csv">CSV</button>
  <button type="button" data-export="html">HTML</button>
</div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const DEFAULT = ["Deutschland", "Frankreich", "Italien"];
  const TITLE = "Rendite zehnjähriger Staatsanleihen";
  const EXPORT = {width: 1200, height: 700};
  if (window.innerWidth < 700) document.querySelector(".country-picker").open = false;
  const data = await (await fetch("data/yields.json")).json();
  const countries = Object.keys(data).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "de"));
  const fromHash = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.replace(/^#laender=/, ""))
    .split(",").filter(name => countries.includes(name));
  const list = document.getElementById("country-list");
  for (const name of countries) {
    const label = document.createElement("label");
    label.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" value="${name}"> ${name}`;
    label.firstChild.checked = (fromHash.length ? fromHash : DEFAULT).includes(name);
    list.append(label);
  }
  const chart = document.getElementById("yield-chart");
  const chosen = () => [...list.querySelectorAll("input:checked")].map(box => box.value);
  // Sources of the chosen countries only, so every export names its own sources.
  const source = () =>
    "Quelle: " + [...new Set(chosen().map(name => data[name].quelle))].join(", ");

  // On the page: short title, source as caption below the chart (fits phone screens).
  function figure() {
    return {
      data: chosen().map(name => ({
        type: "scatter", mode: "lines", name,
        x: data[name].monat, y: data[name].rendite_pct,
        hovertemplate: "%{y:.2f} %<extra>" + name + "</extra>"
      })),
      layout: {
        title: {text: TITLE},
        template: "plotly_white", separators: ",.", hovermode: "x unified",
        yaxis: {title: {text: "Rendite in %"}},
        legend: {orientation: "h", y: -0.12},
        margin: {t: 50, b: 40, l: 60, r: 10}
      },
      // Image export only via the buttons below, which add title and source.
      config: {displaylogo: false, responsive: true, locale: "de",
               modeBarButtonsToRemove: ["toImage"]}
    };
  }
  // Standalone figure for exports: countries in the title, source inside the image,
  // fixed size so the source line is placed reliably.
  function exportFigure() {
    const fig = figure();
    return {
      data: fig.data,
      layout: {
        ...fig.layout, ...EXPORT,
        title: {text: TITLE + ": " + chosen().join(", ")},
        legend: {orientation: "h", y: -0.07},
        margin: {t: 70, b: 110, l: 70, r: 30},
        annotations: [{text: source(), xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0, y: -0.17,
                       xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false,
                       font: {size: 12, color: "#6c757d"}}]
      },
      config: {displaylogo: false, responsive: true, locale: "de"}
    };
  }
  function draw() {
    const fig = figure();
    document.getElementById("country-count").textContent = fig.data.length;
    document.getElementById("yield-source").textContent = source();
    history.replaceState(null, "", "#laender=" + encodeURIComponent(chosen().join(",")));
    return Plotly.react(chart, fig.data, fig.layout, fig.config);
  }
  function save(blob, filename) {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = filename;
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
  }
  const german = value => String(value).replace(".", ",");
  const exporters = {
    png: () => Plotly.downloadImage(exportFigure(),
                                    {format: "png", ...EXPORT, filename: "renditen_auswahl"}),
    svg: () => Plotly.downloadImage(exportFigure(),
                                    {format: "svg", ...EXPORT, filename: "renditen_auswahl"}),
    csv: () => {
      const lines = ["Monat;Land;Rendite in %"];
      for (const name of chosen()) {
        data[name].monat.forEach((month, i) =>
          lines.push(`${month};${name};${german(data[name].rendite_pct[i])}`));
      }
      lines.push("", source());
      save(new Blob(["﻿" + lines.join("\r\n")], {type: "text/csv"}), "renditen_auswahl.csv");
    },
    html: async () => {
      // Self-contained file: plotly.js from this site is inlined, no CDN needed.
      const plotly = await (await fetch("assets/plotly.min.js")).text();
      const fig = exportFigure();
      fig.layout.width = fig.layout.height = undefined;
      const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="de"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>${fig.layout.title.text}</title><script>${plotly}<\/script></head><body>
<div id="chart" style="width:100%;height:90vh"></div><script>
const fig = ${JSON.stringify(fig)};
Plotly.newPlot("chart", fig.data, fig.layout, fig.config);
<\/script></body></html>`;
      save(new Blob([html], {type: "text/html"}), "renditen_auswahl.html");
    }
  };
  list.addEventListener("change", draw);
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-export]").forEach(button =>
    button.addEventListener("click", () => exporters[button.dataset.export]()));
  await draw();
  chart.dataset.ready = "1";
})();
</script>
```
